releaseNotes: Fixed: movies and shows had lost their embed sources (RiveStream, MovieNerds and the other quick providers) since 1.16.49; they are listed again, in the same two halves. New: with VR content on, the Adult tab on Home has a VR Scenes row that streams VR scenes from the tube sites that carry them (most are the flat cut of the VR scene; the title says the format). Adult sites checked one by one: NoodleMagazine, PornRaw and JustFullPorn play again, ad tiles are no longer listed as videos, TugFlix is new, and sites that are gone or lead only to paid pages were removed (Fux, HypnoTube, TabooFantazy, WatchXXXFree, 5MoviesPorn, LetMeJizz, KRX18) (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.55). The on-screen keyboard now fits a phone held sideways: Done sits next to the text box at the top (it was cut off below the screen), the keys shrink on short screens and the keyboard scrolls if it still does not fit. This is the keyboard used to enter IPTV logins, server addresses, keys and searches. Telegram: Settings has Pair Telegram (scan the code, press Start), and Send log file now needs it: you type a few words about what went wrong and the log (keys and tokens removed) reaches the developer on Telegram with your name, and the bot thanks you. Search: typing an actor's name in Search now lists the actor, and OK opens their movies and shows. Home server library: you can add a Windows PC, NAS or router share (SMB) by address, with a login kept on the device or entered on your phone; its videos are matched like the DLNA ones and play through the app. Source lists learn which sources start fast and which keep failing, and put the reliable ones first. The cover and cast card now appears while the stream loads and stays for 8 seconds. Favorites: when your TMDB list cannot be changed the message now says the paired TMDB account must be the one that owns the list. When a movie or episode starts, its cover and the faces of the main cast appear in the lower left for 5 seconds, then fade away; Audio and subtitles now has Cast and characters, the full cast with photos and the characters they play. Typing a long key with the remote is no longer needed: Settings > Trackers (MDBList key, Trakt Client ID and Secret) has On my phone, which shows a QR code; scan it, paste the key on your phone (same Wi-Fi) and it goes straight into the TV. Source lists fill in faster: debrid and the embed providers are each searched in two halves, so the best torrent sources and the quick providers are listed first and the full search adds the rest a moment later, and RiveStream no longer holds the whole embed search up. 3D: with 3D content on, adult titles also list their 3D releases (tagged 3D), and VR releases are no longer mistaken for 3D ones (their side-by-side words describe the VR layout). VR: with VR content on, the Adult tab on Home has a VR row (XXXClub first) next to the Adult menu's VR section. The app window now starts large and can be resized on a headset. Voice: a microphone button in the top bar (next to Search) listens to you and understands phrases like 'play Marshals from yesterday', 'play the latest Marshals episode', 'play season 2 episode 3 of ...', 'next episode of ...', 'show me horror movies', 'show me new releases', 'show me action movies', 'show me Pixar' and 'show me Sydney Sweeney movies' (a genre or list opens that list, a studio opens its films, an actor opens their page). It keeps listening through short pauses and prefers titles you already watch. Your own media servers: Settings > Media servers adds Plex (link code or address and token, so a Plex on a seedbox works too), Jellyfin and Emby (address, user and password; https addresses with a path work, so a seedbox works); what is on them is offered first as a source of the same title and plays straight from the server. Settings > Home server library finds a NAS or media PC that shares its videos over DLNA / UPnP and offers its videos as sources (SMB shares are not supported yet). Linking a Plex account also adds Plex's free channels to Live TV > Free TV (new, needs more testing). Clear errors: Settings now says when a premium service plan ends or no longer works and when an IPTV portal does not answer, and an empty source list says why. Skip recap, skip intro and skip credits cards for episodes. Screen time limits and a bedtime per profile (with the Parent PIN to override). Sources you picked before are remembered and listed first next time. Find English subtitles online from the Audio and subtitles menu when a stream has none. New episode alerts and an Airing This Week row, and Because You Watched rows. Phone remote (Settings > Phone remote): search and play from a phone's browser (off by default, needs a 4-digit code). Playback stats overlay: press INFO (or choose it in Audio and subtitles) to see picture size, frame rate, decoder, dropped frames and buffer. The app now adapts to the device: lighter picture cache, fewer parallel downloads, a smaller visualizer and smaller player buffers on boxes with little memory, it gives memory back when Android asks, and it starts a little faster (startup profile). Favorites: the Radio tab now shows only your radio favorites as its top row (it was showing your movie and TV favorites and Continue Watching); hold OK on a station there to remove it. Movies shows its own Favorites row first (movies only) and TV Shows shows its own (shows only). Highlighting your profile button in the top bar now shows that profile's Continue Watching row. Next episode / next movie: the card now appears when the credits are expected to start (about the last 5 percent of the video: 1 to 2.5 minutes for an episode, 2 to 6 minutes for a film) and counts down to the end, where the next one starts by itself; OK plays it at once. It says Next episode for shows and Next movie for films in a series. New: age limits for profiles. When you add a profile (or open it in Settings > Profiles and choose Age limit) you can limit it to titles up to 14+ (PG-13 / TV-14), 7+ (PG / TV-PG) or little kids (G / TV-Y / TV-G); anything above the limit, and anything without a rating, is hidden in every list, search, actor page and Continue Watching, and a limited profile has no Adult section. Settings > Profiles > Parent PIN asks for a PIN before a limited profile can open the Profiles page or switch to a profile with fewer limits. Auto-play: when a film that belongs to a series ends (Back to the Future 1, then 2, then 3), the next film starts by itself with the best source found, and after the last one you return to the main hub; episodes play in order the same way and the last aired episode returns to the main hub (Settings > Play next episode / movie). My Teams: the team picker lists every team of the league (all NBA teams, no hockey teams under NBA), the teams you already follow are marked Following and can be unfollowed from the list. Fixed the app jumping back to the Home position whenever the on-screen keyboard opened on a tablet or phone (typing a profile name, a PIN or a search). New: a profile button in the top bar (next to Search and Cast) shows who is watching and switches profile in one step. Cast: a cast icon in the top bar and the players opens one list of the TVs and speakers on your network (Google Cast devices and DLNA TVs); pick one and whatever you play next goes to it, and you can pick it before starting a stream. Favorites: adding from a poster's hold menu or a title's page now always works - if a TMDB list is set but your TMDB account is not paired, the title is kept on your profile and shown with the list; with your TMDB account paired, every favorite you add or remove in the app is also added to or removed from your TMDB list (a private 'Starfleet Favorites' list is made if you have not set one). My Teams: each profile now keeps its own teams everywhere - the Sports widget showed the previous profile's teams, or lost your own after switching back, because its saved rows were shared between profiles; they are now kept per profile and follow your teams. Playback: videos from VOE and the hosts behind it (playmogo, vidload) download in several parts at once, so they no longer stall; live games recover at once when the stream falls behind instead of showing 'Source error' every few minutes. Games: NHL games from the OnHockey list that were filed under 'Tomorrow' in the evening show as live (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.54). Downloads: hold OK on a movie or episode to download it with your debrid service, with Settings > Downloads to follow them. Tablets: double-tap a top-bar section to put the selector on it, and the TV Guide works by touch. VR viewer: sharper picture and it stays paused when you take the headset off. The app counts how many people install it, once, anonymously (updates are not counted and nothing identifies you). Personal source keys are no longer packed in the app. Cast: the cast button in the player now hands the stream to a Chromecast or other Google Cast device over your home network, including protected sports streams. Debrid pairings, tracker logins and IPTV providers are now saved in your Google account backup (only the small login files), so they come back when you install on another device signed in to the same Google account. Games: stream links that the site itself refuses are left out of the source list and duplicates are listed once. Quest and other headsets: the app works with the controller ray and thumbstick. Fixed the next-episode countdown: pressing OK (or tapping the screen or the countdown) now starts the next episode at once; the remote's OK used to only show the control bar. Games find more streams: a hockey game opened from the OnHockey list now gets every title-based source (PPV, ReedStreams, Footy4U, SlapStreams, MethStreams and the live-site providers), and the different ways a game is named (Hurricanes vs Jets, Carolina vs Winnipeg, CAR vs WPG, a score in the title) all match; the search is given a fixed time so the list still comes quickly (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.51). Streams are no longer prepared in advance at start-up (their addresses go stale); they are made when you open the game. A channel offered as a source for a game (TSN 3) plays from your own provider when the free list has no link. Touch screens, tablets and VR headsets: the app stays inside the status and navigation bars (the top menu and bottom icons were hidden behind them), fits both the height and the width when the screen is turned, a mouse or controller ray highlights what it points at, the mouse wheel or thumbstick changes the Home row, and the built-in VR viewer zooms with the wheel and shows its controls on a tap. VR content setting, VR viewer, 3D setting, tracker marks, favorites by hold OK, IPTV as a game source, debug log and radio search from earlier builds are included. The end of an episode no longer freezes when the next one should start. Wrong episode fixed: a torrent pack that does not contain the episode you picked no longer plays a different one (episode 1); the next source is tried instead, and file names like 1x03, T01E03, Season 1 Episode 3 and E03 are recognised (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.42). Episodes that have not aired yet no longer show in a show's episode list or in Continue Watching (checked against TMDB air dates). Audio and subtitles button is always on the movie / episode player bar, lists every audio track and says when a track cannot be played on the device. Audio language: Live TV now has an Audio button in the top bar when the stream offers more than one language or track, and the movie / episode / sports player's Audio and subtitles menu now appears for streams that list several languages in one group. Fixed 'Source error' on PPV and MethStreams on boxes that also have Kodi installed: Kodi's own stream relay was holding the port this app's relay needed, so the relay never started and the streams went to the player without it. The app now uses its own port. A Referer-protected stream is also relayed when its playlist check fails (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.41). The debug log now names the host being played and whether it went through the relay. Favorites everywhere: hold OK on a Live TV channel (Live widget, TV Guide, Favorites list), on an episode, or on an Adult / Anime / Sports / Radio item to add or remove it. Live TV's dialog has a Favorites row, each plugin menu has a Favorites entry at the top, favorite episodes sit in the Favorites row of Movies / TV Shows, and the TV Guide's long-press menu adds or removes the channel (its Favorites group was already there). Watched checkmarks and 'continue where you left off' now work without any tracker account for Adult and other plays too (kept on this device per profile). Anime and Sports widgets open instantly from the last answer and refresh in the background; they are also built a few seconds after the app starts. BuffStreams sources resolve when the game search is busy (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.40). Fixed 'Source error' on sports streams: PPV, MethStreams, GStream24, SlapStreams and VoloKit. Streams whose host wants a Referer are now always played through the app's built-in relay (the hosts turned the box's player away with a 403), PPV asks for a fresh address when an edge refuses one, and VoloKit/MethStreams video hidden inside picture files is unpacked (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.39, Resolver 1.4.21). The PPV list no longer misses its window on a slow box (games' page sites are fetched ahead of time). Adult: hosts are no longer written off after one slow connect, Streamtape links resolve again, and the torrent site check works (cloudscraper added). PPV sports (and the other sports feeds on the same streaming edges) play again: their video is hidden inside picture files, and the check that unpacks it could be skipped after one slow answer, so the player was handed pictures it cannot read. Those streams are now always unpacked, a slow check no longer drops a source, and the relay asks again when an edge refuses a segment (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.36). New in Settings: Debug logging (On/Off) records what the player, sources and resolvers do, and Send log file uploads that log with keys and tokens removed and shows a short address to pass on (or saves it on the device if the upload services do not answer). Live TV: a channel that stays on 'loading' while its sound plays (the picture stays blank until the app is force-stopped) now gets a fresh player after 12 seconds before you are told it is taking too long. Fixed choosing a channel from a different category or section playing the channel that was already on (it needed a second try): the player was still using the old category's channel list. The TV Guide now opens on the last channel you watched (from Live TV, the guide or channel zapping), looking further down the list for it when needed. Fixed channels taking too long to load and playing sound only after changing the playback speed a few times: the replaced player kept its video decoder and the box ran out of video memory; it is now freed at once. Fixed the TV Shows, Anime, Sports and Settings widgets not loading: moving past a tab before it had finished loading marked it as loaded-and-empty for good (and it was kept that way for ten minutes); now a tab that was cut short or came back empty is loaded again the next time it is highlighted. Update downloads now use a file name that carries the version, so an update can never hand out an older copy from a download cache (the 32-bit box was served 1.16.8 as 1.16.9). Fixed the picture freezing while the sound plays on after choosing a speed: the video view stayed attached to the old player when the player was rebuilt. The old player is now stopped, the picture is attached to the new one, and the new one keeps the title's watch progress. Widgets load much faster. Favorites that come from a TMDB list are now kept on the device (and refreshed in the background) instead of being downloaded page by page every time; the Python side is started when the app opens instead of when the first widget needs it; the app no longer limits itself to 5 downloads at a time, which was queueing the ten pages of every list; and the Home widgets now appear one by one as each list arrives. Fixed the player closing right after a stream started (a stream that failed or stopped early was taken for a finished video; now only a video watched to its end returns to its widget or episode list). Fixed the speed button (1.25x/1.5x/1.75x) not changing the speed: your box sends the sound out untouched whatever the setting, which cannot be sped up, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. Widgets load faster: Favorites and Continue Watching appear at once from what is on the device (before the Simkl/Trakt lists are asked for), and the Movies and TV Shows widgets appear one by one as each list arrives instead of all at the end. Fixed the player speed button (1.25x / 1.5x / 1.75x) not actually speeding the video up: audio passthrough and tunneled video are played untouched by the hardware, which cannot change speed, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. The VLC engine now keeps the chosen speed when the stream (re)starts. When a movie ends it returns to that movie's widget, and when an episode ends it returns to that show's episode list (on the season that was playing). New setting, Settings > Play next episode: when on, the next episode starts by itself with the best source found. Backing out of a movie or show now returns to the widget row and poster it was opened from, not the Home position; the hub keeps its widgets so it comes back instantly. Favorites, Continue Watching and watchlist titles are now saved on the device too (kept through app updates), so those rows appear at once instead of waiting on the network. New playback speed button in the player controls: cycles 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x. The new HazMat TV icon and TV banner. Back now steps out one level at a time. In the player the first Back closes the control panel and the next leaves; a movie or show started from the Home widgets returns to that widget, in its section and on its poster; in Live TV Back goes channel, then categories, then the hub's Live TV section; in the TV Guide Back opens the groups, then returns to the hub; from anywhere in the hub Back goes to the Home position and one more Back exits the app. The Movies, TV Shows and Home lists are saved on the device and shown at once on the next start (and kept through app updates), then refreshed in the background every six hours. Fixed the TV Guide closing the app when a group was chosen. The Home carousels no longer stop at the first few titles: every favorite, every Continue Watching and watchlist title and ten pages of each TMDB list (New Releases, Top Rated, Popular, Upcoming...) are there. Live TV and the TV Guide use the same colors as the rest of the app. Coming back from a channel puts you on the channel you were watching, in the category you were in. The TV Guide is redesigned in the TiviMate style: a preview and program details at the top, channels down the left, a time line across; Left / Right move between programs, Up / Down between channels, OK plays, hold OK previews a live channel or sets a reminder, Left on the first program opens the groups. Movies and shows you have watched on Simkl or Trakt show a check mark (and their episodes in the episode list). The player has an Audio and subtitles picker (another audio track, other subtitles, or off), Left / Right skip during playback, and Down steps into the control bar (Left / Right move along it, OK presses a button, Up goes back to the picture); the bar stays up while you use it. Watched episodes (and movies) show a check mark, and sources are listed IPTV first, then best quality first, then most seeders. Movies and shows now list debrid sources (torrents and release-site hosters) once a debrid service is paired, and picking one plays it through your service. Pairing a premium service or tracker (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) shows a QR code next to the address and code, a service that does not answer the first time is retried, and finishing a pairing no longer shows a load error. Movies and TV Shows have a Favorites row, hold OK on a poster to add or remove a favorite, and Radio shows your Continue Watching and Favorites. HazMat TV is now built the Starfleet way: Home with widgets (highlight Movies, TV Shows, Live TV, Anime, Sports, Radio or Settings to see its widgets), autoplay trailers in English, Continue Watching, Favorites (on your profile or a TMDB list), cast with photos (open an actor to see everything they have been in), release and air dates, certification and the content advisory. Pair premium services and your trackers (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) in Settings; IPTV movies and shows are a source on every title and listed under IPTV Movies / IPTV TV Shows. Profiles, My Teams alerts (including the FloHockey leagues), split screen (side by side or top and bottom, mixing IPTV, movies and live sports), and Left / Right now skip back and forward during playback. Your IPTV providers, debrid pairings and trackers carry over from the old version. Needs Android 7 or newer.
